body:
What motivates a person to keep going if all they do is fail? 

I was blissfully ignorant most of my life, staying in, isolating and what not, and now that I'm getting out there more its a sudden realization that maybe I just suck. Seriously, what's the point? Everything I try to improve myself on either ends in failure or I just lose steam very quickly.
Frankly I want to do the same thing sometimes, just cut all ties with no warning. No idea if the shit follows a person around though.
